headline: The Biggest Mistakes in Kitchen Fire Cleanup You Should Avoid
articleBody: When a kitchen fire happens, it's natural to want to jump in and start cleaning, but making a few common mistakes can actually make the damage worse. First off, never attempt to clean electrical appliances that have been exposed to fire or water; they could be dangerous. Another big no-no is trying to clean smoke-damaged walls or ceilings with regular household cleaners. This can smear the soot and make it much harder for professionals to remove. You'll also want to avoid running your HVAC system, as this can spread smoke particles and odors throughout your entire home. And don't throw away damaged items before your insurance adjuster has seen them; documentation is key for your claim. To avoid these pitfalls and ensure your kitchen is restored properly, it’s often best to call in professionals who have the right tools and expertise.
